quarterly_data.quarter: Enplas press release: FY2027.3 First-Quarter Results Presentation (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor business 1Q FY2027.3: sales JPY 7,878 million (+61.2% YoY), operating income JPY 2,012 million (+132.2%). Company: sales for server applications increased significantly - demand for AI-server sockets expanded strongly, driven by accelerated growth in GPU- and ASIC-related applications amid the growing adoption of AI agents, as well as a new increase in demand for CPU-related applications.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor sales JPY 7,878 million (+61.2%); operating income JPY 2,012 million (+132.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Enplas press release: FY2027.3 First-Quarter Results Presentation (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company guidance (unchanged from April 30, 2026; planned rate JPY 150/USD): FY2027.3 sales JPY 48,000 million, operating income JPY 6,400 million, profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 5,000 million; 1st half sales JPY 24,300 million, operating income JPY 3,900 million. Semiconductor segment sales forecast JPY 29,000 million for the year (JPY 15,200 million in the 1st half). Company: Semiconductor sales are expected to increase significantly on strong servers and automotive SoCs; for AI servers, in addition to major GPU manufacturers, ASIC-related projects for hyperscalers are expected to increase.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027.3 sales JPY 48,000 million; operating income JPY 6,400 million; Semiconductor sales JPY 29,000 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Enplas press release: FY2027.3 First-Quarter Results Presentation (07-29-2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: Enplas press release: FY2027.3 First-Quarter Results Presentation (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor mid-term targets (Mid-term Management Plan 2nd roll, to 2029.3): sales CAGR of 12% or more; burn-in socket growth-market sales ratio from 75% to 85% (2029.3); expand business in AI servers, general-purpose servers, automotive SoCs and mobile, and expand mass-production orders related to ASICs for hyperscalers; enter the growing system-level test (SLT) market with test sockets, targeting a 25% SLT market share (2031.3).

players.product: Plastic optical fiber lenses / lens arrays for optical transceivers (1.6T optical transceiver lenses in mass production), lens connectors, and CPO components for 3.2T / 6.4T (samples)

quarterly_data.quarter: Enplas press release: FY2027.3 First-Quarter Results Presentation (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Digital Communication business 1Q FY2027.3: sales JPY 457 million (+8.8% YoY), operating loss JPY 121 million. The launch of new lens connector products has been delayed, with launch now forecast in 2027.3 2Q or later (the April 30, 2026 assumptions had mass production in 1Q). Mass production of next-generation 1.6T optical transceiver lenses for high-end areas such as AI has launched; Network Solutions sales are expected to increase on new-product mass production. FY2027.3 Digital Communication sales forecast JPY 3,000 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Digital Communication sales JPY 457 million (+8.8%); FY2027.3 forecast JPY 3,000 million; 1.6T lenses in mass production

quarterly_data.quarter: Enplas press release: FY2027.3 First-Quarter Results Presentation (07-29-2026)
